"Father?"

Riven reacts too late.

IMPACT.

hits the dirt,

The unknown attacker remains obscured by smoke.

There has NOT been an extended fight.

This exact state leads directly into the next sequence:

Riven on the ground with her intact sword beyond her reach.

Dark.

Mysterious.

Sudden.

Violent.

Cinematic.

RIVEN'S INTACT SWORD IS KNOCKED AWAY.

RIVEN LIES ON THE GROUND.

THE INTACT SWORD IS BEYOND HER REACH.
